_source: Script v2 (design/script_v2.md d4; applied 5 Oct 2026), from Blueprint H2 (page overview) and H3 (panel script). Text only; layout, residue and the spirit-light first-light line live in content/pages/*.json (Garv). Fragment text is in evidence.json, referenced by id. 'drawn' is art direction, not on-screen text. Speech tone is the H3 bubble note. Narration boxes are always the investigator; speech bubbles are always the witness. (v1's twistNarration lines were folded into the spirit-light first-light lines.)

mira.title: The Bell at 2:17
mira.setting: Schoolhouse and clock tower, incident night
mira.layout: 2x3 grid; P3/P4 centre emphasis; P6 wide bottom
mira.openingNarration: The bell stopped the same way every clock did.
mira.closingNarration: The evidence was clearer than the memory.

panels.drawn: Mira in classroom; register and clock visible.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.line: The lesson ended before the bell.

panels.narration: The village still looked ordinary before the minute that broke it.

panels.drawn: School clock, wall clock and register.
Clock tower rope untouched; lantern symbol glowing in stone. Under the light: 'E.V.' scratched on the bell frame.
panels.narration: No hand had pulled the rope. Something else had.

panels.drawn: Mira writes in the wall ledger by her own wristwatch.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.line: This was written after the bell.

panels.narration: The clocks had stopped. Her pen hadn't.

panels.drawn: Sickroom doorway: black residue and the silhouette's hand on the frame, holding a lantern staff with cracked glass. Under the light: a teal handprint on the door frame; the Figure's rim shows a lantern with cracked glass.
panels.narration: I knew the tools before I knew the face.

panels.drawn: Register with a scraped entry beside Nia's sickroom note.
panels.narration: Someone had scraped a name from the register: [[Elias Vane]].

arun.title: The Dry River
arun.setting: River road and sluice path, incident night
arun.openingNarration: A ferryman remembers water. Arun remembered it leaving.
arun.closingNarration: The time on his watch was the time they erased.

panels.drawn: Riverbank; boat tied at normal water level.
panels.narration: The water was the last ordinary thing he remembered.

panels.drawn: Arun's watch ticking while the tower shows 2:17.
panels.narration: The watch remembered a different night.

panels.drawn: Open emergency sluice and dry river channel.
panels.narration: No drought leaves a riverbed this clean.

panels.drawn: Silhouette carrying a child across the dry riverbed toward the lantern-house. Under the light: teal footprints across the riverbed; the Figure's rim shows a long coat and a high collar.
panels.narration: He walked where the river should have been.

panels.drawn: Close on the figure; lantern case with a scratched patch. Under the light: 'E.V.' on the case.
panels.narration: That case. I had seen one like it.

panels.drawn: River floods the channel; ghost echoes appear in the water.
panels.narration: The same water carried the same memory twice.

leela.title: The Lantern Below
leela.setting: Lantern workshop and underground archive, minutes before and after the overload
leela.silhouette: P4 and P6 at the lantern console
leela.openingNarration: The lantern had rules. Leela had written every one.
leela.closingNarration: The machine did not malfunction. Someone told it to do this.

panels.drawn: Echo Lantern workbench with diagrams. Under the light: 'E.V.' carved into the apprentice's stool.

dialogue.speaker: leela
dialogue.line: It records. It extracts. It can transfer.

panels.narration: The lantern was never a simple lamp.

panels.drawn: Village network blueprint; rules board. Under the light: rule two on the board, pencil margin notes on the blueprint.

dialogue.speaker: leela
dialogue.line: Never connect all nodes at once.

panels.narration: The warning was written in her own hand.

panels.drawn: An empty child-sized chair with straps; Nia's clinic card clipped to it (no hairclip).
panels.narration: Someone had already asked the lantern a question it could not answer.

panels.drawn: Young Elias (silhouette) at the console with the staff, Leela reaching for him.
panels.narration: She remembered his words. Not his face.

panels.drawn: Console overload; village map lights across every node; black residue spreads.
panels.narration: The lantern did what it had been told to do.

panels.drawn: Archive collapsing; silhouette at the purge control. Under the light: the Figure's rim at the console reads young and slight.
panels.narration: After the overload, someone took his own name out of the evidence.
